edition.headline: In November 2026, a million AI tokens cost a median $4.00 from frontier models (no change), $4.00 from mid-range models (no change) and $0.26 from small models (no change). A typical AI subscription cost $20.00 a month (no change), and top plans cost $200.00 (no change). Changes compare with October.

corrections.text: This edition first said frontier-model prices fell 12.5%, to $3.50. No list price had fallen: Moonshot AI and Anthropic changed their lineups, the old rows could no longer be verified, and they were left out. The same saved pages now give Moonshot's current flagship, Kimi K3.1 Pro ($4.00 blended), and Anthropic's highest plan, Claude Ultra ($200 a month). Frontier is $4.00 with no change. Top plan stays $200.

corrections.text: The original Mistral note described Large 4 as a preview at $0.68/$2.09 and described Medium 3.5 as recommended for most tasks. In a later November 1 check, Mistral dates Medium 3.5 deprecation to October 31, recommends Large 4 for new integrations, and lists Large 4 Standard at $0.70 input and $2.10 output per million tokens. The Large 4 price at the edition capture time has not been independently established. Medium 3.5 tier eligibility is under review; the originally published basket and index values remain unchanged pending that review.

original.basketNote: Mistral calls Medium 3.5 'frontier-class' and recommends it for most tasks. Its newer Mistral Large 4 is a public preview on sale at $0.68 / $2.09 and is not presented as more capable, so it holds no tier.

corrections.text: An archived copy of Mistral's official Large 4 model page, timestamped November 1, 2026 at 13:01:46 UTC, displays US$0.70 input, US$0.07 cached input and US$2.10 output per million tokens. This is a separate earlier observation, retrieved through the Internet Archive. The original 13:18:19 UTC capture retained model identity but not the Large 4 tariff; the archive does not establish whether a tariff changed between 13:01 and 13:18. The original basket, index values and unresolved tier-assignment review remain unchanged.

Follow-up correction: Medium 3.5 is withheld from November's frontier basket because it is not Mistral's current flagship. The original November 1 model captures name Large 4 as its successor, and Mistral's retained October 6 announcement positions Large 4 as its most capable model. Deprecation alone is not the exclusion rule. No Large 4 price has been inserted: its exact tariff at the original capture remains unproved. The frontier basket has six constituents, with its $4.00 median unchanged. This is a basket omission, not a like-for-like price cut. Under the edition's captured Gemini price schedule, the conditional December outlook becomes $6.00 (+50%), not an observed price increase. Medium's recorded $1.50 input/$7.50 output and all earlier values remain in this correction's original data.
